messages:
tess: quick q — migrating legacy-orders to ExternalSecrets (Vault backend). I opened PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567. Main worry: secret rotations causing k8s Secret to change and triggering rolling restarts. Anyone seen this pattern and have a recommendation?
chen: I ran into this last month. external-secrets controller updates the k8s Secret resource on rotation, which will trigger Deployments if they watch that secret. How are you mounting it? env var or file mount?
tess: mounting as file via projected volume (CSI driver + external-secrets sync -> k8s Secret -> projected). deployment uses Helm chart from charts/apps with default restartOnSecretChange=true. snippet of the mount:```yaml
volumeMounts:
  - name: creds
    mountPath: /etc/secret
    readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: creds
    projected:
      sources:
        - secret:
            name: legacy-orders-secret
            items:
              - key: token
                path: token
```
priya: two quick options we use: 1) disable automatic restart in the Helm values for this chart (so the controller update won't force rollout), 2) use a tiny sidecar that watches the file and SIGHUPs the app so you don't restart entire pod. Both are acceptable depending on app behavior.
sam: also FYI infra-bot rolled the ExternalSecrets operator to v0.11.2 yesterday which changed the default sync behaviour for some CRD fields — worth checking controller release notes. If operator now rewrites secret metadata more often that could make rotations noisier.
chen: +1 on sidecar. For stateless apps we usually set helm value `apps.restartOnSecretChange=false` (chart-specific) and add a k8s liveness check that handles reloading. If you need zero-downtime reload, a sidecar that writes to tmp + atomic move works well.
tess: good pointers. Is there a recommended annotation to mark "do not restart" so future rolls don't re-enable?
priya: we don't have a global annotation for that, it's per-chart. Add a note in values.yaml and annotate the Deployment with: `infra.redwood.com/secret-handling: "sidecar"` so it's discoverable. Add the runbook section too.
chen: one more quick test you can do: patch the Deployment to `spec.template.metadata.annotations['rollback-secret-v']` with a random value to force a controlled restart and verify app picks up new creds without full image redeploy. Command: `kubectl patch deploy legacy-orders -n prod --type='strategic' -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"restartedAt":"'"$(date -u +%s)"'"}}}}}'`
infra-bot: controller-rollout: ExternalSecrets operator upgraded in prod on 2025-01-08 — PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4499.
tess: thanks all — I'll update PR to set `restartOnSecretChange: false` in chart values for legacy-orders and add runbook note for sidecar option + test steps. pinging for quick review @chen @priya @sam :thumbsup:
chen: I can review in ~30m.
priya: lgtm once you add the runbook note.
sam: quick nit: include the operator version matrix in the PR description.
tess: added both notes + operator matrix. merging after reviews. cheers!
